name: flop-swap-desk
description: Atomic swap desk on FLOP: a non-custodial swap profile over tclk/1 (two HTLC legs, one statement), a read-only board/watcher, and a keyed local client. Alpha; no rail holds mainnet value.

scripts.test:anvil: npm run build && forge build && vitest run --config vitest.anvil.config.ts
scripts.test:regtest: npm run build && vitest run --config vitest.regtest.config.ts
